method: Read-only server-side unpdf native text extraction; six-English-word signatures >=30 normalized characters against stored passages/stems, every linked week; candidate search includes retained temporary/import-source PDFs. No OCR or LLM. Shared passages can repeat across exams: candidate matches alone do not authorize reassignment. Full match does not certify layout, page numbers, image-only questions or every character. No original PDFs or credentials exported.
rootCause: Before a2ce3c4 (2026-10-19), original files were stored at sanitized filename without week namespace, using upsert:true. Korean names collapsed to underscores; later uploads overwrote PDFs referenced by earlier weeks. Current unique week/UUID keys and upsert:false prevent filename collisions.

confirmedCase.recovery: Correct original was not identified among retained PDFs; original from user or historical backup required. Student questions/answers/grades unchanged.

localFixes: Fail before question synchronization when original upload or week-link persistence fails.
Teacher source-image generation now checks legacy PDF identity, uses printed question number/full region and registered fonts; mismatch returns422 before rendering/uploading.
deployment: Release requested after audit. Unique week/UUID filenames and upsert:false prevent replacement on collision; persistence failure and teacher source-identity guards are included in the release. See Git history and deployment for release status.
